title: nan
authors: Wu Z.; An H.; Wu B.; Wang H.; Lu K.
key_contribution: Presents a visual-inertial fusion mapping and localization system using AprilTag with factor-graph optimization and Error-State Kalman Filter for GNSS-denied scenes, validated in simulation and reality.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
